policies: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY tablename,policyname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policies p WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('events','event_participants','rounds','matches','match_players','match_results','event_team_sides','event_team_matches')
acl: SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'grantee',CASE WHEN grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE grantee::regrole::text END,'grantor',grantor::regrole::text,'privilege',privilege_type,'grantable',is_grantable) ORDER BY c.relname,grantee,privilege_type) FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) WHERE c.oid IN ('public.events'::regclass,'public.event_participants'::regclass,'public.rounds'::regclass,'public.matches'::regclass,'public.match_players'::regclass,'public.match_results'::regclass,'public.event_team_sides'::regclass,'public.event_team_matches'::regclass)
column_acl: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'column',a.attname,'grantee',CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE x.grantee::regrole::text END,'grantor',x.grantor::regrole::text,'privilege',x.privilege_type,'grantable',x.is_grantable) ORDER BY c.relname,a.attname,x.grantee,x.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(a.attacl) x WHERE c.oid IN ('public.events'::regclass,'public.event_participants'::regclass,'public.rounds'::regclass,'public.matches'::regclass,'public.match_players'::regclass,'public.match_results'::regclass) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
